decision: Relocate the existing Chrome-only native presentation implementation into kde/chrome/presentation.rs with its original Rust namespace/private parent.
reason: Chrome separator/presentation quirks must be editable independently from generic native observation transport and GNOME presentation.

authority_scope: No authority or delivery behavior change in this mechanical move.
